newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open flat to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open flat to firmer.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open flat to firmer on Tuesday, but gains made overnight in gold soon ran into resistance.
COMEX December gold was seen opening flat to $0.50 an ounce firmer from Monday's close of $382.80 an ounce, after trading in a $383.50 to $382.40 an ounce range in overnight ACCESS trade.
COMEX gold warehouse stocks were unchanged Monday at 1,059,959 ounces.
COMEX silver was due to open flat to up 1.0 cent, after trading on ACCESS between $4.91 and $4.875.
In London bullion was fixed Tuesday morning at $381.60 an ounce, up from Monday afternoon's fix of $380.50.
In London silver fixed at $4.905 an ounce, up from $4.835 on Monday.
COMEX silver stocks were unchanged Monday at 133,256,943 ounces.
NYMEX January platinum and NYMEX December palladium were both due to open $0.50 to $1.00 an ounce higher.
